dct_description_sm: "The purpose of this GIS is to provide the basic data layers and tables required to support the petroleum assessment, data for further exploration and development, and index of known data"--CD-ROM insert.
Also available via Internet from the USGS web site. Address as of 9/20/07: http://pubs.usgs.gov/of/2006/1179/; current access via PURL.
Contributors: Afghanistan. Vizārat-i Maʻādin va Ṣanāʼiʻ.; Geological Survey (U.S.); Steinhouer, Douglas W.; United States. Trade and Development Agency.
